# origincloud_kms_grants (Data Source)

Lists a key's grants that haven't expired, in every zone, ordered by name. A grant made moments ago may be missing from the list until its zone's change arrives. Needs `kms.grant.list` on the project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) The key whose grants to list. Its `id`, the full resource name `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}`. `project` and `region` must be the ones it is in.
- `project` (String) The project whose grants to list.
- `region` (String) The region whose grants to list.

### Read-Only

- `grants` (Attributes List) The grants listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--grants))

<a id="nestedatt--grants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grants`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the grant was made. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `delegate` (String) Who made the grant.
- `encryption_context` (Map of String) The encryption context a use must carry, exactly; never empty.
- `expire_time` (String) When the grant stops opening anything unless renewed before. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `grantee` (String) The platform host or zone workload the grant is for, by the SPIFFE ID its certificate names, which ends in `/zones/{zone}/hosts/{host}` or `/zones/{zone}/workloads/{workload}`.
- `id` (String) The grant's full resource name, `//kms.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/keys/{key}/grants/{grant}`: what an argument that refers to the grant takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The grant's resource name.
- `operation` (String) What the host may do with the key. One of `DECRYPT`.
- `renew_time` (String) When the grant was last renewed, or made. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `ttl` (String) How long the grant lives from now: 1 to 60 minutes. A duration in seconds, such as `90s` or `1.5s`.
- `zone` (String) The zone that keeps the grant: its host's.
